params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort order: TRENDING, MOST_POPULAR, or RECENT. Defaults to TRENDING.

params.name: time_window
params.description: Time window for download counts: DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, or ALL_TIME. Defaults to ALL_TIME.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

items.docs: List Knowledge Registry paks with sorting (trending, popular, recent), time window filtering, and pagination.

Fetch file or directory content from a pak by URI. The URI format is: owner/pak_name[@version][/path]
Returns file content for files, or a recursive directory tree for directories.

info.name: Get Knowledge Registry Pak Install Info

items.docs:
Resolves pak metadata for installation and records a download event.
The URI format is: owner/pak_name[@version]

info.name: Publish a Pak to the Knowledge Registry

items.docs:
Publishes a pak version to the registry. Creates the pak if it doesn't exist, otherwise creates a new version.
The CLI handles git operations (commit, tag, push), then calls this endpoint to index the pak.

params.name: owner
params.description: Owner name when searching by identifier.

params.name: pak_name
params.description: Pak name when searching by identifier.

params.name: query
params.description: Freeform keyword query. Used when owner/pak_name are not provided.
